title: The Cow Killer That Has Never Killed a Single Cow

scenes.text: It's called the cow killer. It has never killed a single cow.
It looks like a fuzzy red ant. It's actually a wasp, and only the wingless females sting.
One entomologist compared the sting to hot oil from a deep fryer spilling over your hand.
Its stinger is nearly as long as its whole abdomen.
Predators barely get a chance. Its seamless shell bends under crushing instead of cracking.
And first, it chirps a loud warning. The cow was never in danger. The name just stuck.

description:
It's called the cow killer, and it has never killed a cow.
The velvet ant is a wasp with an armored shell, a stinger nearly as long as its abdomen, and a sting compared to hot oil from a deep fryer.
Would you pick one up?
first_comment: Would you pick up a fuzzy red velvet ant? Tell us the weirdest insect you have met.
